items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: The mention of Everett Hull is contained entirely within a bracketed note by the interviewer/editor, not in the interviewee's spoken response.

ctx.x: Ampegey, yes. Then further on they had, the Ampegey company, I think, made those little baby basses, you know, the frame, basses on a small frame?
*Everett Hull developed the AMPEG PICKUP AND amplifier around 1950 or '51. (there were earlier pickups.)
Uh-huh. Oh, yeah, I've seen those. I've seen those, yeah, those streamlined like (inaudible), but so Pettiford, so you like the way Pettiford got over the instrument at that time?
